text: The Warrior class specializes in slaying enemies with attacks.
translation: 战士职业擅长用攻击击杀敌人。

text: The Fiend is highly attuned to Lightning.
The Titan is an unmovable beast on the battlefield.
translation: 泰坦是战场上不可撼动的巨兽。

text: Cast a ball of magma at a nearby enemy, with a chance to set them on fire.
translation: 向附近的敌人施放一颗熔岩球，并有几率将其点燃。

text: Throw a spear of pure lightning, inflicting powerful Lightning ailments. If Lightning Spear hits an enemy affected by Jolt, it will consume the Jolt to deal 200% of the Jolts effect as More Damage.
translation: 掷出一支纯粹闪电之矛，施加强大的闪电异常状态。若闪电之矛命中受震荡影响的敌人，将消耗其震荡，造成相当于震荡效果200%的更多伤害。

text: Channel a stream of Lava towards a nearby enemy, dealing massive Fire damage in an area.
translation: 引导一股熔岩流喷向附近的敌人，在范围内造成大量火焰伤害。

text: Cast a ball of ice at a nearby enemy. Deals 25% splash damage. Frost Orb cannot pierce or chain.
translation: 向附近的敌人施放一颗冰球。造成25%溅射伤害。寒冰宝珠无法穿透或连锁。

text: Cast statically charged particles around you. Charges cannot Chain.
translation: 在你周围施放带有静电充能的粒子。充能无法连锁。

text: Throws a slow, heavy axe dealing extremely high damage.
translation: 掷出一把缓慢而沉重的斧头，造成极高的伤害。

text: Throws a single explosive bomb which detonates after a delay, dealing massive damage. Shrapnel Bomb is not affected by extra projectiles.
translation: 投掷一枚爆炸炸弹，延迟后引爆，造成大量伤害。破片炸弹不受额外投射物影响。

text: Slam the ground and release a powerful shock wave towards a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area.
translation: 猛击地面，向附近的敌人释放一道强大的冲击波，在范围内造成伤害。

text: Nearby Enemies count as Poisoned. Nearby Enemies take 20% More Damage.
translation: 附近的敌人视为中毒。附近的敌人受到20%更多伤害。

text: Skill never deals Critical Strikes, but deals More Damage.
translation: 技能永不造成暴击，但造成更多伤害。

text: Deal more Physical Damage with Melee Attacks, and inflicts Hamstrung for 4 seconds on hit.
translation: 近战攻击造成更多物理伤害，并在命中时施加断筋，持续4秒。

text: Skill deals more damage with critical strikes.
translation: 技能的暴击造成更多伤害。

text: Chills and Freezes inflicted have more effect.
translation: 施加的冰缓与冰冻效果更强。

text: Skill converts some Physical damage into Cold Damage
translation: 技能将部分物理伤害转化为冰冷伤害

text: Skill affects a larger area, and will deal more area damage
translation: 技能影响范围更大，并造成更多范围伤害
技能造成更多火焰伤害

text: Cold Damage with skill penetrates Cold Resistance on enemies.
translation: 技能的冰冷伤害穿透敌人的冰冷抗性。

text: Convert a portion of Lightning Damage into Cold Damage.
translation: 将一部分闪电伤害转化为冰冷伤害。

text: Convert a portion of Lightning Damage into Fire Damage.
translation: 将一部分闪电伤害转化为火焰伤害。

text: Ailments inflicted by this skill have a chance to inflicted the enhanced version as well.
translation: 此技能施加的异常状态有几率同时施加强化版本。

text: Damage over Time inflicted by this skill deal more damage.
translation: 此技能施加的持续伤害效果造成更多伤害。

text: Chills and Freezes inflicted by this skill have increased effect.
translation: 此技能施加的冰缓与冰冻效果增加。

text: Infections inflicted by this skill spread to more nearby enemies.
translation: 此技能造成的感染会传播给更多附近的敌人。

text: Mow down enemies with a machine gun.
Chance to gain Swiftness Boon on Hit
translation: 命中时获得迅捷赐福的几率

text: Chance to gain Swiftness Boon on Kill
translation: 击杀时获得迅捷赐福的几率

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Cold Damage per Precision Boon
translation: 每层精准赐福：物理伤害作为额外附加冰冷伤害

text: Increased Area of Effect per Toughness Boon
translation: 每层坚韧赐福：增加作用范围
每层迅捷赐福：闪电伤害

text: Physical Damage Converted to Toxic Damage
translation: 物理伤害转化为毒素伤害

text: Cold Damage Converted to Fire Damage
translation: 冰冷伤害转化为火焰伤害

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Cold Damage
translation: 物理伤害作为额外附加冰冷伤害

text: Lightning Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage
translation: 闪电伤害作为额外附加火焰伤害

text: Fire Damage as Extra Added Toxic Damage
translation: 火焰伤害作为额外附加毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage taken as Toxic Damage
translation: 承受的物理伤害视为毒素伤害

text: Cold Damage taken as Fire Damage
translation: 承受的冰冷伤害视为火焰伤害

text: Cold Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage against Chilled Enemies
translation: 对冰缓敌人：冰冷伤害作为额外附加火焰伤害

text: Sometimes one must take a hit to make it through to the end.
translation: 有时必须承受一击，才能撑到最后。

text: A goblin is alone without a tribe. A tribe of Buff-Boons.
translation: 没有部落的哥布林形单影只。一个由增益赐福组成的部落。

text: Elemental dread at the pull of a string.
translation: 扣动弦线，元素恐惧随之而来。

text: Become a stalwart defender in critical times.
translation: 在危急时刻成为坚定的守卫者。

text: Skill is cast when hitting an enemy with any non-triggered skill. Skill consumes all Boons to deal 20% more damage for each consumed Boon. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills.
translation: 使用任意非触发技能命中敌人时，施放该技能。该技能消耗所有赐福，每消耗一个赐福便造成20%更多伤害。该技能不会自动施放，且无法触发其他技能。

text: 12% of Increased Projectile Speed also applies as More Projectile Damage
translation: 投射物速度增加的12%同样作为更多投射物伤害生效

text: Every 10 seconds, gain 20% Maximum Life Regenerated per Second for 1 seconds.
translation: 每10秒，每秒再生20%最大生命，持续1秒。

text: Deal 20% More Damage if you've been hit in the past 5 seconds
translation: 若你在过去5秒内被命中，造成20%更多伤害

text: 35% Less Damage taken from Damage over Time
Curses have 10% Less effect. Curses on enemies are spread to nearby enemies when they are killed
translation: 诅咒有10%更少的效果。敌人身上的诅咒会在其被击杀时传播给附近的敌人

text: Skills have 15% More Cast Speed. Duration skills have 30% Less Duration
translation: 技能有15%更多施法速度。持续类技能有30%更少的持续时间

text: Every 5 seconds, switch between dealing 20% More Area Damage, and having 40% More Area of Effect
translation: 每5秒，在造成20%更多范围伤害与拥有40%更多作用范围之间切换
附近的敌人受到30%更多伤害

text: Deal 15% More Damage if you've killed in the past 5 seconds
translation: 若你在过去5秒内击杀过敌人，造成15%更多伤害

text: Bleeding and Ruptured enemies explode on death, dealing 50% of the remaining total Bleed and Rupture Damage on them to nearby enemies.
translation: 处于流血或破裂状态的敌人死亡时会爆炸，对附近的敌人造成相当于其剩余流血与破裂总伤害50%的伤害。

text: Every 10 seconds, gain 30% More Cast Speed for 4 seconds
translation: 每10秒，获得30%更多施法速度，持续4秒
中毒的敌人受到20%更多伤害

text: Enemies that hit you are marked with Transfusion. Transfused Enemies take 50% More Damage Over Time.
translation: 命中你的敌人会被施加输血印记。被输血的敌人受到50%更多持续伤害。

text: Your Lightning Damage can inflict Toxic Ailments.
translation: 你的闪电伤害可以施加毒素异常状态。

text: Capped Block Chance also applies as More Damage.
translation: 达到上限的格挡几率同样作为更多伤害生效。

text: Gain 1% Increased Lightning Damage for every 200 Total Evasion, up to 5000%
translation: 每200点总闪避，获得1%增加的闪电伤害，最高5000%

text: All Evasion is converted into Armor
Cannot use non-Bomb Damaging Skills. Bombs Skills fire double Bombs.
translation: 无法使用非炸弹类的伤害技能。炸弹技能发射双倍炸弹。
